data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 2509: https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2509. Local verification before push: `make lint` passed, `make typecheck` passed, and `make test` passed after running with `FORCE_COLOR` unset and `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=all` because this host's Git 2.55 safe.bareRepository=explicit otherwise makes tests that read intentionally-created bare test remotes fail. The code diff is docstring-only in `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/snapshot_lagfree_refresh.py`.
